verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS email API and its SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions any telemetry opt-out for the SDKs, dashboard or account. Event Webhook and Deliverability Insights are about email event data, not about the user opting out of vendor telemetry, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
